name: Rasdeep
description: Rasdeep is a outer-arm system, steady enough for beacons and strange enough for rumors. Survey crews logged eccentric comets and a trojan swarm before moving on to richer claims. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

stars.name: Ashen Hearth
stars.description: A G-class star burning yellow, the dependable engine of its court. Surface granulation churns visibly, and flare seasons come like clockwork. Every chart in the arm uses it as a bearing star, willing or not.

planets.name: The Iron mark
planets.description: Dune seas bury everything but the oldest basalt spires. The wind never stops, and the sand sings at dusk through the canyons. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

moons.name: Storm Flint III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Meridianfield
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Dust devils wander the basins, and the night side glitters with ice. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

moons.name: Drowned Pebble II
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

planets.name: Silenthollow
planets.description: Methane haze wraps a slushy mantle, cold and blue and utterly calm. Faint rings tilt at an angle that bothers the mathematicians. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

planets.name: Kilnmark
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Its ring shepherds keep the lanes clear and the rumors plentiful. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

dwarfPlanets.name: Moss Outer 59
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

comets.name: Grey Lantern
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
